patchScope: Only generated run-function CodeSection/body lengths and instructions; original Core, host, imports, exports, locals, owner/source proofs and metadata byte accounting remain unchanged.
comparisonScope: as-is versus selected generated-code variant in the same frozen Core/host; primary/reverse and independent as-is/as-is AA. Benchmark later cutoff sample>=4.
ceilings: omit is diagnostic only and deliberately violates the clock contract
future-bias is admitted only for the two fixed non-timestamp workloads; no shipping correctness claim
recorded resource/unit byte counts remain original owner metadata; compiled byte lengths are recorded separately
all setup and ordinary benchmark semantic guards remain unchanged; extra time-bank guard is deferred until the first post-run public guard access
timingUse: none; all benchmark timing fields are discarded

oldCapture.scope: optional one-instruction cold generation after comparisons; its times are not recorded or compared

ceiling: Synthetic private-memory kernels in selected imported profiles. Timings exclude reset/import/output guards, but include run snapshots and phase costs. FP loops include their recorded reset/control instructions. Undefined multiply/divide flags are masked. First completion is not an independent cold-start sample. No game/native-SIMD/peak-allocation claim.
